story.title: Story 3: Turn Composition and Chunk Formation

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 3 AC-3.1 through AC-3.9 against the story, tech design, test plan, changed turn/chunk derivation code, provider double behavior, and configured gates. Most turn composition, gap, placement, deterministic chunking, and independent retry mechanics are implemented and covered, but AC-3.8/TC-3.8 lacks the required tool-activity receipt/outcome preservation proof for detailed versus brief chunk summaries.

newFindings.title: TC-3.8 does not prove detailed summaries preserve receipts while brief summaries preserve outcomes only
newFindings.evidence: Story lines 44-45 require detailed and brief chunk summaries to differ semantically: detailed preserves tool-activity receipts and brief preserves outcomes only. The implemented summary handler in packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/derive.ts:126-145 reads only member projections and passes the same { memberProjections } shape to both provider operations. The provider double in packages/lhc/test/fixtures/provider-double.ts:148-153 derives both summaries from the same joined projection text with only the operation marker differing. The TC-3.8 test in packages/lhc/test/derivation-turns.test.ts:481-507 uses a simple prompt/answer turn, asserts only distinct detailed()/brief() marked content, and never creates a tool-run receipt fixture or asserts that detailed carries receipt content while brief strips to outcomes. This leaves a required TC-3.8 assertion unverified.

verified: AC-3.1 / TC-3.1: closed turn drains to ready turn_rendering and lower_band_projection independent rows.
AC-3.2 / TC-3.2: failed smoothing falls back to raw prompt, rendering remains ready, and gap records message/form.
AC-3.3 / TC-3.3: repaired smoothing does not mutate the existing gapped rendering; explicit direct requeue rebuilds and clears the gap.
AC-3.4 / TC-3.4: captured composeTurnRendering input carries ordered tool parts with outcomes including the failed call.
AC-3.5 / TC-3.5: turn read-back includes stored chunkId and memberIdx after derivation.
AC-3.6 / TC-3.6: accumulated crossing closes the prior chunk and starts the incoming turn in the next chunk, including threshold equality coverage.
AC-3.7 / TC-3.7: oversized projection self-chunks and closes immediately, including the behind-open-chunk case.
AC-3.8 partial: close queues detailed and brief summary work as separate items with independent states/retry/requeue behavior.
AC-3.9 / TC-3.9: replayed identical event streams produce identical chunk/chunk_member snapshots and summary artifacts.
unverified: AC-3.8 / TC-3.8: detailed summary preserving tool-activity receipts while brief summary preserves outcomes only is not evidenced by code or tests.

productionPathFindings: Production summary path currently invokes detailed and brief providers with the same memberProjections-only input; no production code or required test evidence proves the AC-3.8 receipt-versus-outcomes distinction.
additionalObservations: No fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real execution path was found in the audited production turn/chunk derivation path.
Configured story and epic gates both passed, but the blocking AC-3.8 proof gap prevents verifier pass.
